Title: Public preview: New Azure Maps Creator feature - Dataset with GeoJSON

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Creator enables you to create Indoor Maps with GeoJSON.

Azure Maps Creator has added a new feature, Dataset with GeoJSON. With this new feature, you can now create your entire indoor map with GeoJSON. For more information, see the create a dataset using a GeoJSON package article.

To get started with Azure Maps and Azure Maps Creator, see the Azure Maps documentation or create a free Azure Maps account.
